candidate_selection.diversity_algorithm: hierarchical: distinct champion -> distinct Final Four -> points-weighted distance
candidate_selection.ev_definition: sum_R pts_R * sum_{t in picked_R} P(t wins R), marginals from the unconditional bank
candidate_selection.p1_definition: P(bracket score >= max opponent score) over shared trials
candidate_selection.p1_opponent_model: ESPN public pick distribution + seed pairwise referee
candidate_selection.sampler: champion quotas (proportional with floor) then EV strata within champion

holdout.contamination_reason: 2026 is inside BACKTEST_YEARS, the production strategy was selected on a window containing it, and a documented modelling conclusion was drawn from its outcome. It is an integration/regression season, not a benchmark.

preferences.frequencies_source: full scenario bank, never the candidate artifact

product.p1_disclosure_required: P(1st) assumes a 30-opponent pool with ESPN public pick behaviour. It is not a universal probability of winning any pool.

supersedes.reason_superseded: TRAIN_YEARS extended through 2026. The 2026 season concluded in April 2026, so it is ordinary historical data for a 2027 prediction. Decided ex ante on 2026-08-20, before any 2027 information existed, and NOT on the basis of any 2026 performance comparison. 2026 remains permanently barred as an evaluation season; this concerns training data only.
